nodes.label: Root Layer
nodes.rationale: Bridge between 3D world and 2D UI via React state and refs without triggering unnecessary UI re-renders

nodes.label: 3D Engine Layer
nodes.rationale: Dedicated to WebGL canvas, rendered by GPU using Three.js

nodes.label: 2D User Interface Layer
nodes.rationale: Traditional HTML/CSS layer on top of 3D canvas intercepting clicks only where visible UI elements are

nodes.label: Core Managers
nodes.rationale: Utility classes outside React lifecycle to ensure high performance

nodes.label: Domain-Driven Architecture
nodes.rationale: Strict directory structure to separate WebGL, DOM UI, audio, and core logic. Never mix 3D Canvas logic with DOM UI logic

nodes.label: State Management
nodes.rationale: Use Zustand global store, no React Context or prop-drilling. Prevent unnecessary re-renders

nodes.label: Performance & Memory Management
nodes.rationale: Avoid memory leaks. Dispose Geometry/Material, use declarative R3F. Track audio nodes. Pre-allocate vectors outside useFrame

nodes.label: Global State via Zustand
nodes.rationale: No prop-drilling or React Context. No local useState across WebGL/DOM boundary. Use src/core/store.js

nodes.label: The WebGL / DOM Boundary
nodes.rationale: Communicate via zustand. Do not mount DOM elements deeply within 3D scene

nodes.label: Performance & Memory Strictness
nodes.rationale: Avoid imperative new THREE inside render loops. Garbage collect audio. Pre-allocate vectors outside useFrame loop

nodes.label: Audio Resonance Engine
nodes.rationale: Bespoke Web Audio API synthesizer layering algorithmic dissonance and harmony based on depth
